summary: CIBN's ACIB professional examination route is for registered student members, with exam fees and annual subscriptions cleared before selecting the eligible Diploma, Intermediate Professional or Chartered Banker papers.
feeLabel: Exam fee varies by level and number of subjects
feeNote: CIBN's current Capacity Building & Certification page publishes different fees for Diploma, Intermediate Professional and Chartered Banker papers. Confirm the amount shown for the candidate's level and selected subjects before payment.
timeline: CIBN's FAQ says examination registration occurs several times during the year and candidates are notified when a window opens; registration must be completed before that window closes.
requirements: An approved CIBN student membership before the intended examination
The CIBN student membership number, which also serves as the professional examination number
Current annual subscription and any required outstanding payment cleared before exam registration
Eligible examination papers at the candidate's Diploma, Intermediate Professional or Chartered Banker stage
Payment of the current examination amount through the examination portal rather than another CIBN payment category
steps: Sign in through CIBN's official website or examination portal with the registered student membership details.
Confirm the candidate's current ACIB level and the papers eligible for the active examination window.
Clear the annual subscription and any required membership payment before selecting examination papers.
Select the exam papers and centre, review the current level-specific examination fee and pay it through the examination-payment route.
Submit the selected papers and centre, download or keep the examination docket, and obtain the required authentication before presenting the docket for admission to the examination.
notes: CIBN's professional examination has Diploma, Intermediate Professional and Chartered Banker stages.
CIBN warns candidates not to pay examination fees into exemption, subscription or another unrelated portal because those payments are not counted as exam fees.
Exam-centre changes must be requested within the registration rules for the active examination window.

title: How to renew a CIBN annual membership subscription
summary: CIBN members can renew annual subscription from the member portal by checking outstanding payments, selecting the current subscription and paying through Paystack, OPay or the CIBN e-wallet.
feeNote: CIBN's current renewal page lists ₦5,000 for Student Members, ₦3,000 Ordinary, ₦10,000 Microfinance Certified, ₦18,000 Associate, ₦35,000 Honorary Senior and ₦37,500 Fellows.
timeline: The membership dashboard is updated after a successful payment; CIBN does not publish one fixed processing delay for every payment channel.
requirements: An existing CIBN membership ID and portal password
The current annual subscription and any other outstanding item shown in the member dashboard
A Paystack, OPay or CIBN e-wallet payment method offered on the renewal page
steps: Open the CIBN member portal and sign in with the Membership ID and password.
Find Outstanding Payment on the dashboard and select Click to Pay.
Select the current annual subscription and any other outstanding items that the member intends to clear.
Choose Paystack, OPay or E-Wallet and complete the payment instructions.
Return to the member profile after payment and confirm that the outstanding subscription has been cleared.
notes: Subscription amount depends on the member's grade rather than one universal CIBN fee.
Keeping the annual subscription current can affect access to examinations and other Institute services.
CIBN's current main-site renewal table supersedes older subscription figures still visible on legacy portal pages.

title: How to register as a CITN professional student member
summary: CITN's professional-student route is for eligible graduates/HND holders and qualifying undergraduates, using the online application, certified documents and current student-registration payment.
feeNote: CITN's current qualification page states that the ₦12,000 professional-student registration fee includes subscription and identity card; annual subscription is billed at ₦1,500 after registration.
timeline: CITN sends account activation and then approval/decline communication after the online application and document/payment checks; no universal number of processing days is published.
requirements: A first degree, HND or equivalent plus NYSC certificate for the standard professional-student route
For the undergraduate route, the required O-level credits plus admission and Head-of-Department recommendation evidence
Certified documents uploaded with the online application
The applicant's signature and passport photograph
Payment of the current professional-student registration amount through the CITN online route
steps: Open CITN's Professional Student page and confirm whether the applicant uses the graduate/HND route or the undergraduate route.
Choose Become a Professional Student Member and complete the online application form.
Upload the certified qualification/NYSC or undergraduate evidence, signature and passport photograph requested by CITN.
Select Proceed to Payment, generate the reference and complete the current student-registration payment through the official online channel.
Check the email inbox and spam folder for CITN's account-activation message and later approval or decline notice.
notes: CITN currently states that undergraduates who meet its conditions receive a 50% cost-reduction package.
The ₦12,000 current registration fee includes the initial subscription and identity card, while later annual student subscription is separate.
Professional-student registration is required before using the normal CITN professional examination route.

title: How to register for a CITN professional examination
summary: CITN professional students register for an active CBE/CBT examination diet by signing in, updating the profile and subscription, selecting the exam centre and eligible subjects and paying through the official portal.
feeLabel: Exam fee varies by papers and active diet
feeNote: CITN publishes diet-specific examination charges and registration notices. Use the amount shown for the candidate's eligible subjects in the current examination portal.
timeline: CITN opens registration by examination diet. Its latest 2026 news includes registration for the October 2026 CBE & CBT professional diet; users should confirm the currently active diet before paying.
requirements: An approved CITN professional-student account
An up-to-date student profile and any annual subscription required for the examination diet
The eligible examination subjects displayed for the candidate
A selected examination centre from the options offered for the active diet
Online payment of the examination fee shown by CITN
steps: Sign in to the CITN student portal and confirm the student's profile and financial/subscription status.
Open the registration link for the currently active professional examination diet.
Select the examination centre and review the eligible subjects automatically displayed for the candidate.
Select the papers to be written, review the generated examination amount and complete the official online payment.
Save the examination registration confirmation and later check the portal for timetable, venue, docket or CBT/CBE instructions.
notes: CITN examination registration is diet-specific, so old deadline dates should not be reused for a new diet.
The active examination format can include computer-based examination or computer-based testing depending on the paper/diet.
A student should confirm current subscription and profile details before starting the exam registration.

title: How to renew a CITN membership or student subscription
summary: CITN members and students can renew outstanding subscription from MYCITN using the RENEW bill and supported Webpay, Quickteller, Flutterwave or GlobalPay channels, with Quickteller and bank transfer alternatives.
feeNote: CITN publishes category-specific annual subscription rates and outstanding bills in the member portal. Check the MYCITN bill before payment rather than using an old amount.
timeline: CITN states that services are activated automatically and the member profile is updated after a successful payment; manual evidence can be sent when a payment is not reflected.
requirements: An existing CITN member or student profile and membership/student number
The outstanding subscription bill shown in MYCITN or the Quickteller CITN payment lookup
A supported payment method through Webpay, Quickteller, Flutterwave, GlobalPay or the listed bank-transfer route
steps: Open the CITN member login, sign in and choose MYCITN.
Select RENEW to display the outstanding subscription bill.
Choose Proceed to Payment and select Webpay, Quickteller, Flutterwave or GlobalPay.
Complete the payment and return to the CITN profile to confirm the financial status has updated.
If the payment does not reflect, send the payment evidence with the payer name, membership number and reference to the official CITN support address shown on the payment page.
notes: CITN also supports direct Quickteller subscription payment using the membership number.
The provider's current page also lists a direct bank-transfer option with evidence requirements.
Online transaction charges can apply in addition to the subscription amount.

title: How to apply for CITN induction after the professional examinations
summary: CITN graduate students apply for Associate induction from the membership profile by completing the induction form, generating a payment reference and paying the current graduate-student induction charge.
feeLabel: Graduate-student induction fee currently ₦105,000 plus ₦20,000 form
feeNote: CITN's current Scale of Professional Fee lists ₦20,000 for the graduate-student associate membership form and ₦105,000 induction fee. Confirm the amount generated in the live portal before paying.
timeline: CITN does not publish one universal completion time for every induction application; the application is reviewed after the graduate submits the form and payment.
requirements: A CITN graduate-student profile that is eligible for Associate induction
The member/student login credentials for the CITN membership portal
A completed induction form and any membership information requested in the profile
Payment of the current graduate-student induction form and induction amount generated by CITN
steps: Sign in to the CITN member portal with the graduate student's username, membership number or email and password.
Open My Membership and choose Apply for Induction.
Complete the induction form and review the applicant information before submission.
Choose Proceed to Payment to generate the reference and pay the current induction amount through the official payment channel.
Keep the reference/payment evidence and monitor the member profile or CITN communication for the induction approval and event instructions.
notes: The direct-member induction route has different fees and should not be confused with the graduate-student induction process described here.
CITN's current fee table lists the graduate Associate form and induction fee separately.
Induction follows completion of the relevant CITN professional route and is not the same as exam registration.

title: How to buy and activate an MTN 5G broadband router
summary: MTN Nigeria's 5G Router route combines buying the current broadband device, registering the router SIM, activating the device bundle and optionally linking the router number to a primary MTN line for easier management.
feeNote: MTN's current Broadband and Devices pages list the 5G Router at ₦40,000. Device pricing and activation promotions can change, so confirm the live MTN amount before purchase.
timeline: The device can be used after the router SIM has been registered/activated and the applicable broadband bundle is active; MTN does not publish one universal completion time for SIM registration at every outlet.
requirements: Availability of MTN 5G coverage in the intended usage area
An MTN 5G Router purchased through an official MTN route
Registration of the router SIM at an MTN SIM registration point before use
A broadband bundle or activation offer applied to the registered router SIM
steps: Open MTN Nigeria's Broadband page and check 5G coverage for the location before ordering the current 5G Router.
Buy the 5G Router through the official MTN order/shop route and keep the purchase details.
Take or use the included router SIM through an MTN SIM-registration point and complete the required subscriber registration.
Follow MTN's 5G Router activation guidance to activate the broadband offer or buy the preferred router bundle.
Optionally dial *312*500# from the primary MTN line and follow the device-linking menu so the router number can be recharged and managed more easily.
notes: MTN's current 5G Router help says the router SIM must be registered at an MTN SIM registration point.
MTN publishes *312*500# as the device-linking and management route for broadband devices.
Activation-bonus volumes are promotional and can change, so this guide does not treat one bonus figure as permanent.

title: How to renew an MTN broadband router data bundle
summary: MTN broadband-router customers can resubscribe through myMTN NG, MTN eShop, myMTN web, Zigi, USSD or MoMo, including linked-device USSD options for buying data from a primary line.
feeLabel: Bundle price depends on the selected router plan
feeNote: MTN router bundles and unlimited-plan prices vary by plan and can change. Review the current broadband bundle shown in the chosen MTN channel before payment.
timeline: The selected data bundle is activated after the payment succeeds on the chosen MTN channel; MTN does not publish one fixed delay across every payment method.
requirements: The MTN broadband Router/MiFi device number or a primary MTN line already linked to the device
A selected current broadband data or unlimited router bundle
Access to myMTN NG, MTN eShop, myMTN web, Zigi, USSD or MoMo
Enough airtime, wallet balance or payment method for the selected bundle
steps: Choose one of MTN's official broadband resubscription channels: myMTN NG, eShop, myMTN web, Zigi, *461#, *312*500# or MoMo *671*2#.
Enter or select the broadband device number and open the Broadband Router bundle options.
Choose the current data or unlimited bundle and review the plan price, allowance/speed and validity before payment.
Complete the airtime, card, wallet or other payment requested by the selected MTN channel.
Check the router balance or bundle status in the MTN self-service channel and keep the transaction reference if the bundle does not appear.
notes: MTN publishes *461*1# for router bundles and *312*500# for linking/managing broadband devices.
A primary mobile number can buy a bundle for the router device through the Buy for Others/device-number flow.
Unlimited 5G-router plans are subject to MTN's current usage-threshold policy.

title: How to order and install MTN FibreX
summary: MTN FibreX is a fixed-fibre service available only in covered locations; customers check availability, select an unlimited speed plan and place an order that currently includes free installation and a free-to-use router.
feeLabel: Plans currently start at ₦30,000 for 30 days
feeNote: MTN currently lists unlimited FibreX plans from ₦30,000/50Mbps to ₦200,000/1Gbps for 30 days, with free installation and a free-to-use router. Confirm location availability and current plan price before ordering.
timeline: Installation timing depends on FibreX availability, address survey and scheduling; MTN does not publish one universal installation time for every eligible Nigerian address.
requirements: A home or business address within a location currently covered by MTN FibreX
A selected FibreX speed plan that suits the intended connection
Customer contact and address information for the order and installation visit
Payment for the selected FibreX subscription after MTN confirms the service can be installed at the address
steps: Open MTN's official FibreX page or coverage checker and confirm whether the intended address is within a current FibreX location.
Compare the available unlimited FibreX speed plans and their current 30-day prices.
Choose Order/Get FibreX and submit the address and customer contact information requested by MTN.
Follow MTN's availability/survey and payment instructions after the address is confirmed for installation.
Allow the MTN team to install the fibre service and free-to-use router, then use the FibreX account-management or support channels for activation and later plan management.
notes: MTN currently advertises free installation and a free-to-use router with FibreX.
FibreX is address-dependent; being in a listed city or state does not guarantee that every street is already covered.
MTN's current FibreX contact channels include 352, 0803-102-1700, WhatsApp 0916 000 8217 and MTNBroadband.NG@mtn.com.
